final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), av AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.cnt, g.cnt - av.avg_cnt AS diff FROM g JOIN av ON av.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC, g.account_id, g.region LIMIT 10
